title: Story message label, BDLI, animation-command, and audio-cue follow-up

scope.baseline_flow_version: ACNH 1.0.0 B_data/EventFlow source exports used by the prior story crosswalk.
scope.supplemental_message_archive_version: Unknown; exact Message/*.sarc.zs files in the supplied supplemental archive are classified as new_path in extracted_manifest.json and have no independent per-file game-build metadata.
scope.language_identity: Locale code is verified by the language directory and archive basename suffix for each parsed source archive; locale code does not establish game patch/version.
scope.actor_asset_rule: Stage-to-SpNpcParam ResName joins remain static; model catalogue rows remain CAT only. No raw Model/ payload or runtime load is claimed.

evidence_levels.EF: Decoded EventFlow tree source path, entry, event index, and exact MessageID/action parameter.
evidence_levels.MSBT_INDEX: Parsed message archive member, exact label at text_index, and content hash; dialogue text itself is omitted.
evidence_levels.BDLI_INDEX: Exact BDLI message_member plus label-hash candidate and text_index join. Payload bytes/hashes are recorded but page semantics are not inferred.
evidence_levels.CAT: External catalogue metadata/path reference; not proof that the referenced payload is present or used.
evidence_levels.BCSV: Decoded baseline B_data table row join on exact named source columns.
evidence_levels.STRUCT: Parsed member/index exists in the supplied supplemental archive, while exact game build/version identity is unproven.

eventflow_message_bindings.scope: Qualified label lookup; does not validate control flow, rendering or placeholder expansion.
eventflow_message_bindings.resolver_status_caveat: Each selected reference retained resolution=message_archive_not_supplied from the original corpus index. Its languages map was non-null. This follow-up re-opened the exact messages JSON, checked member/text_index/label for every locale, and found the inherited status is a false negative for all selected references.

summary.build_status: Compare content evidence; do not infer exact version from filenames.

coverage.global_binding_summary_context: eventflow_message_bindings.json reports 8,030 matched and 63 missing references per language for its entire corpus; all 460 refs in these selected story flows are among the exact matches after direct verification.
